note: RANKING LOSS ALONE + L2-SP ANCHOR, POSE INJECTION AT ITS SINGLE ORIGINAL SITE. --alpha-pae 0, so the ONLY objective is pose ordering; --rank-form softplus at tau 0.0305, cross-seed, 2 structures x 10 seeds x 5 poses = 100 poses per step. Trainable set is the two pose projections -- linear_no_bias_d (256x39) and linear_no_bias_d_wo_onehot (256x1), 10,240 parameters; pae_ln and linear_no_bias_pae stay FROZEN. NO --pose-perblock: the pose enters the head exactly once, where Protenix put it, so step 0 is the shipped head bit-for-bit -- which --pose-perblock-share can never be, since sharing a pretrained matrix into three blocks that never had it changes epoch 0. WHY THE ANCHOR, AND WHY 1e-3. The two pose projections have ||W_shipped||^2 = 18.18. Measured from 4y3ve6's own checkpoints, the unregularised arm moved them to ||dW||^2 = 3.86 at ep1, 49.23 at ep3, 327.97 at ep9, 910.66 at ep15, 1379.21 at ep19 -- so by epoch 3 the update is 2.7x the squared norm of the weights being updated and by epoch 19 it is 76x, while held-out rank loss bottomed at ep3 (0.03773) and rose to 0.04012 by ep12. The penalty gradient 2*lambda*||dW|| against |g_rank| 7.96e-02 (probe ev3d6u, this exact configuration) is 18% of the task gradient at the ep3 drift and 93% at the ep19 drift: permissive where generalisation peaked, an equal opposing force where the run ran away. In loss terms 0.049 at ep3 against a ranking loss near 0.04. 1e-4 was rejected as 1.8% of the task gradient at ep3, and the one prior null (4x8t44) sat at 2% of the loss. LAMBDA IS NOT TUNED; it is this arm's hyperparameter. L2-SP IS 0-FOR-2 IN THIS PROJECT: 4x8t44 null at 2.0% of the loss, wpg274 did not stop the ordering collapse -- neither carried this objective, but the prior is not favourable. TWO VARIABLES AGAINST 4y3ve6, NOT ONE: the anchor and the removal of perblock sharing. No rank-only arm has previously run without --pose-perblock-share, so a difference cannot be attributed to the anchor alone. CONTROLS: 4y3ve6 (same objective and trainable set, perblock share, no anchor, overfit from ep3) and 8eiek8 (same trainable set, no ranking term). WHAT WOULD FALSIFY IT: drift tracking 4y3ve6's curve anyway, or drift held down while held-out rank loss still turns at epoch 3. THE HELD-OUT MONITOR MEASURES AT alpha_pae 1 or val10 PAE would read 0.0 every epoch and the one metric comparable across all arms would vanish.
